text: Stepping through this glass threshold into a space dedicated to R&D, I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity. The vibrant colors and bold letters invite me to contemplate the process of research and creation. I am reminded that every innovation emerges from both isolation and collaboration; the transparent walls and open feel echo the simultaneous need for solitude and connection in intellectual pursuits. Here, I am both observer and participant in humanity's never-ending quest for knowledge.
